column5: Is there an overt marker for the absolutive?
column8: Absolutive = zero (unmarked); nouns in absolutive case bear no overt suffix

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging on first person pronouns?
column8: 1st person pronouns follow NOM/ACC alignment: ẽ (NOM=A/S) vs. ea (ACC=P); no ergative marking

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging on second person pronouns?
column8: 2nd person pronouns follow NOM/ACC alignment: mĩ (NOM=A/S) vs. bia (ACC=P); no ergative marking

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging on third person pronouns?
column8: 3rd person pronouns: a (3SG, unmarked), atu (3PL.ABS); no distinct ergative pronoun form attested

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging on full NPs?
column8: Full NPs take ergative suffix -N (syncretic with instrumental) on A argument; e.g. tsua-N 'who-ERG', wede-N 'husband-ERG'

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the imperfective aspect?
column8: Ergative marking on full NPs attested in imperfective contexts throughout corpus

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the perfective aspect?
column8: Ergative marking on full NPs attested in perfective contexts throughout corpus

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the past tense?
column8: Ergative marking on full NPs attested in past tense contexts (PST1–PST6 all attested with -N)

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in non-past tenses?
column8: Ergative marking on full NPs attested in non-past (future imperfective) contexts

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the indicative mood?
column8: Ergative marking on full NPs attested in indicative mood contexts

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in non-indicative moods?
column8: Non-indicative moods (imperative, optative, hortative) not described for NP case alternations; unclear

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the realis status?
column8: Ergative marking on full NPs attested in realis contexts

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the irrealis status?
column8: Irrealis/desiderative contexts: no explicit description of NP case alternation; unclear

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the context of an agentive A?
column8: No evidence of agentivity-based split; ergative marking applies to A of transitive regardless of agentivity

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the context of a non-agentive A?
column8: No evidence of topicality-based split in NP flagging

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the context of a topical A?
column8: No evidence of animacy-based split in NP flagging

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the context of a non-topical A?
column8: Ergative marking on full NPs attested in main clauses

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the context of an animate A?
column8: Complement clauses: switch-reference system described but NP case in complements not explicitly discussed

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in the context of an inanimate A?
column8: Ergative marking on full NPs attested in adverbial/switch-reference clauses (e.g. DS clauses)

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in main clauses?
column8: Relative clauses: not explicitly described in available sections

column5: Is there ergative alignment of flagging in non-main clauses?
column8: Other non-main clause types: insufficient data

column8: No evidence of ERG = comitative syncretism; comitative has its own suffix (COM)
